headline: Coca-Cola HBC Completes $2.6 Billion Acquisition of CCBA
summary: Coca-Cola HBC has completed its $2.6 billion acquisition of Coca-Cola Beverages Africa, making it the world’s second-largest Coca-Cola bottler by volume.
why: Coca-Cola HBC is a major bottler of products of The Coca-Cola Company, operating across multiple markets. This large cross-border transaction significantly expands its geographic footprint and production scale in Africa.

impacts.name: Coca-Cola HBC
impacts.why: The company completed a major $2.6 billion acquisition, expanding its bottling operations in Africa.
